Hero.description: Preparing the next generation of Egyptian educators through integrated training in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics — built on inquiry, research, and real-world impact.

CtaOne.heading: OUR MISSION & CORE VALUES
CtaOne.description:
The philosophy of STEM schools aims to move beyond purely academic subjects to integrate science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) and apply them to address major societal challenges.
Therefore, STEM Bachelor of Science and Education programs strive to prepare thoughtful, professional, practicing, and research-oriented teachers capable of self-learning.

physics.course: Science in Education (STEM Education Physics in English)
physics.description: This program integrates advanced physics with modern pedagogy, preparing graduates to teach mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, and quantum concepts in STEM-focused classrooms. Coursework combines theoretical study with laboratory practice, research methods, and supervised teaching experience to build confident, inquiry-driven educators.

chemistry.course: Science in Education (STEM Education Chemistry in English)
chemistry.description: Students explore organic, inorganic, physical, and analytical chemistry alongside education courses that bridge theory and classroom practice. The curriculum emphasizes laboratory safety, experimental design, and the role of chemistry in solving real-world problems across industry, health, and the environment.

biology.course: Science in Education (STEM Education Biology in English)
biology.description: This track examines cells, genetics, ecology, evolution, and human biology through a combination of lectures, labs, and fieldwork. Teaching methodology courses prepare graduates to lead inquiry-based science classrooms and connect biological concepts to sustainability, health, and everyday life.

geology.course: Science in Education (STEM Education Geology in English)
geology.description: The program covers earth systems, mineralogy, plate tectonics, paleontology, and environmental geoscience alongside education pedagogy. Graduates are prepared to teach earth and space science with a focus on field observation, data interpretation, and the role of geoscience in climate and resource challenges.

mathematics.course: Science in Education (STEM Education Mathematics in English)
mathematics.description: Students study calculus, linear algebra, statistics, discrete mathematics, and mathematical reasoning, paired with modern approaches to teaching secondary-school mathematics. The program builds both mathematical depth and the ability to design clear, engaging lessons for diverse learners.

tuition.title: Tuition Fees
tuition.description: 200 EGP per hour per semester + administrative fees (ID card).

graduation.title: Graduation Requirements
graduation.description:
Students must complete 150 credit hours.
Students must achieve a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.0.
Students must pass the Arabic language course.

About.letter: Welcome to the STEM Program at the Faculty of Education, Assiut University. We prepare future teachers to lead the next generation of inquiry-driven science classrooms — integrating science, technology, engineering, and mathematics through hands-on learning, research, and capstone projects that turn academic study into real-world impact.
